title: botrychium virginianum subsp. meridionale
intro: Botrychium virginianum subsp. meridionale, commonly known as rattlesnake fern or southern rattlesnake fern, is a subspecies of fern in the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of B. virginianum subsp. meridionale include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
